modes.semantics: Copied from the cited evidence bundle or rule metadata.
Same level as the required predecessor node.
Opposing branch retains its own level; no silent winner.
Conservative meet: minimum rank among supporting predecessors.

propagation_rules.statement: Observation nodes use declared confidence (usually high) for chart facts assumed given.
Evidence nodes inherit or declare the Evidence Bundle confidence_level.
Inference nodes inherit from the evidence they require unless marked reduced.
Final conclusions use combined mode over supporting intermediate nodes.
Alternative nodes that did not activate use reduced mode.
Contradiction nodes use conflicting mode and must not overwrite the taken path level.
